ranked_results.content: The sub-block architecture of Jasper was designed to facilitate fast GPU inference. Each sub-block can be fused into a single GPU kernel: dropout is not used at inference-time and is eliminated, batch norm can be fused with the preceding convolution, ReLU clamps the result, and residual summation can be treated as a modified bias term in this fused operation.
ranked_results.qasper_evidence_text: The sub-block architecture of Jasper was designed to facilitate fast GPU inference. Each sub-block can be fused into a single GPU kernel: dropout is not used at inference-time and is eliminated, batch norm can be fused with the preceding convolution, ReLU clamps the result, and residual summation can be treated as a modified bias term in this fused operation.
